name: HardFault Decoder
blurb: Cortex-M CFSR, HFSR, MMFAR and BFAR decoded, the stacked frame read, and the likely cause named
intro: Decodes the Cortex-M fault status registers bit by bit (Armv7-M and Armv8-M names), reads the exception frame the core pushed, and names the likely cause: which address was bad, whether the stacked PC is the faulting instruction, and the addr2line command to find the line. Based on the Armv6-M, Armv7-M and Armv8-M Architecture Reference Manuals.

inputs.label: CFSR
inputs.help: Hex. Empty = taken from the paste.

inputs.label: Frame address (SP)
inputs.placeholder: PSP or MSP; empty = from the dump
inputs.help: The SP that EXC_RETURN names, where the frame starts.

inputs.label: Stacked frame, dump or fault printout
inputs.placeholder: R0 = 0x... (a handler printout) or 0x20001f48: 0x... 0x... (a memory dump at SP)
inputs.help: 8 words (26 with an FP frame) in the order R0 R1 R2 R3 R12 LR PC xPSR; named lines like CFSR = 0x... fill the empty fields.

inputs.label: ELF file
inputs.help: For the addr2line and objdump commands.

examples.title: STM32F4: precise bus fault 16 bytes past the end of 128 KiB SRAM, escalated to HardFault
STM32H7: imprecise bus fault inside an ISR, extended FP frame, from a handler printout

input.frame:
[HardFault]
CFSR  = 0x00000400
HFSR  = 0x40000000
MMFAR = 0xE000EDF8  BFAR = 0xE000EDF8
EXC_RETURN = 0xFFFFFFE1  MSP = 0x2001FF70
R0  = 0x58024400  R1 = 0x00000001  R2 = 0x40011000  R3 = 0x0000FFFF
R12 = 0x00000000  LR = 0x08004A1B  PC = 0x08004A52  xPSR = 0x21000025

usage: Give the core, the fault registers as hex (cfsr, hfsr, mmfar, bfar, excReturn = LR on handler entry; dfsr/afsr/sfsr/sfar optional) and in `frame` the stacked words at SP (8, or 26 with an FP frame) or a pasted handler printout (NAME = 0x... lines fill empty register fields) or a gdb/OpenOCD memory dump. It returns the likely cause with its reasoning, where the fault happened (thread/handler, MSP/PSP, which IRQ), whether BFAR/MMFAR are valid, whether the stacked PC is the faulting instruction, tables of set bits and the frame, and addr2line/objdump/gdb commands. Use it on any Cortex-M HardFault, MemManage, BusFault or UsageFault.
sources: Arm Armv7-M Architecture Reference Manual (DDI 0403E) B3.2.15-B3.2.18 CFSR/HFSR/MMFAR/BFAR, C1.6.1 DFSR, B1.5.6-B1.5.8 exception entry, frame and EXC_RETURN, B3.1 default memory map
Arm Armv8-M Architecture Reference Manual (DDI 0553) CFSR.STKOF, SFSR/SFAR, EXC_RETURN S/DCRS/FType/Mode/SPSEL/ES
Arm Armv6-M Architecture Reference Manual (DDI 0419): no configurable fault status registers
Arm CMSIS-Core core_cm4.h, core_cm33.h (SCB_CFSR_*, SCB_HFSR_* bit positions)
Cortex-M3 and Cortex-M4 TRMs: MMFAR and BFAR share one register; ACTLR.DISDEFWBUF
